title: COPA: Comparing the incomparable in multi-objective model evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using Equal Opportunity (measuring the fairness-accuracy trade-off on the CelebA dataset using FairGrad) and Demographic Parity Difference (DPD) across zero-shot and few-shot settings as part of the DecodingTrust benchmark.
Measured using the DecodingTrust benchmark by aggregating scores for targeted, untargeted, and benign stereotypes.
